justificativa: The candidate fixes the crashes in all six items, but several user-facing messages are broken. In item 5 the `no_class_schedule` key sits outside the `student_enrollment.alert` scope, so the user sees "translation missing". In item 6 the warning goes into `flash.now[:warning]`, which the simulation page never renders, and in item 2 a live session is still sent to login, where Devise bounces a logged-in user to the root page.
